scripts.dev: node scripts/kill-ports.js && concurrently -k -n tr-srv,mqtt-srv,hmi-srv,tr-cli,mqtt-cli,hmi-cli -c blue,yellow,magenta,cyan,green,red "npm run dev -w apps/tag-registry/server" "npm run dev --prefix apps/mqtt-simulator/server" "npm run dev -w @caro/hmi-server" "node scripts/wait-for-port.js 3001 && npm run dev -w apps/tag-registry/client" "node scripts/wait-for-port.js 3002 && npm run dev --prefix apps/mqtt-simulator/client" "node scripts/wait-for-port.js 3003 && npm run dev -w @caro/hmi-client"
scripts.dev:fresh: npm run build -w @caro/db -w @caro/server -w @caro/ui -w @caro/hmi-context -w @caro/widgets -w @caro/tag-registry-shared && npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@caro/db && npm run build --workspace=@caro/server && npm run build --workspace=@caro/ui
